item.title: Ceredigion - Welsh <> English Translation Services Framework
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-21T12:00:00+00:00
Ceredigion County Council is reopening its Welsh <> English Translation and Interpretation Services Open Framework. The framework is divided into the following lots: Lot 1 - Text Translation Lot 2 - Interpretation This reopening provides an opportunity for new suppliers to apply for admission to the framework and for existing appointed suppliers to update previously submitted quality responses and/or pricing where they wish to do so. The framework agreement commenced on 8 December 2025 and will expire on 7 December 2033. Suppliers appointed through this reopening will be admitted to the framework from January 2027 until 7 December 2033. The procurement is being conducted electronically through the eTenderWales portal. Instructions and all associated documents are available under itt_128548 Ceredigion - Welsh <> English Translation Services Framework , together with the associated lot-specific itts. Suppliers must submit all responses and queries electronically through the eTenderWales portal. Mae Cyngor Sir Ceredigion yn ailagor ei Fframwaith Agored Gwasanaethau Cyfieithu a Dehongli Cymraeg <> Saesneg. Mae'r fframwaith wedi'i rannu i'r lotiau canlynol: Lot 1 - Cyfieithu Testun Lot 2 - Dehongli Mae'r ailagoriad hwn yn rhoi cyfle i ddarparwyr newydd wneud cais i ymuno â'r fframwaith ac i ddarparwyr sydd eisoes wedi'u penodi ddiweddaru ymatebion ansawdd a/neu brisiau a gyflwynwyd yn flaenorol os dymunant wneud hynny. Dechreuodd y cytundeb fframwaith ar 8 Rhagfyr 2025 a bydd yn dod i ben ar 7 Rhagfyr 2033. Bydd darparwyr a benodir drwy'r ailagoriad hwn yn cael eu derbyn i'r fframwaith o fis Ionawr 2027 hyd at 7 Rhagfyr 2033. Mae'r broses gaffael yn cael ei chynnal yn electronig drwy borth eTenderWales. Mae'r cyfarwyddiadau a'r holl ddogfennau cysylltiedig ar gael o dan itt_128548 - Ceredigion - Welsh <> English Translation Services Framework, ynghyd â'r ITTau perthnasol ar gyfer pob lot. Rhaid i ddarparwyr gyflwyno pob ymateb ac unrhyw ymholiadau yn electronig drwy borth eTenderWales.
